title: Pisa Costs $22 to Climb. Xi'an's Bell Tower? About $4.
description:
Climbing the Leaning Tower of Pisa runs about €20 (~$22). Climbing Xi'an's Bell Tower — a 640-year-old Ming timber tower right in the heart of the old city — costs about ¥30, roughly $4. That's more than five times cheaper for a landmark with far more history under it.

The Bell Tower was first built in 1384 under the founding Ming emperor, near the Drum Tower. As Xi'an's center shifted, the whole 36-meter tower was relocated about 1,000 meters east in 1582 — a plaque on the second floor still records the move.

🧭 Expert Tip: a single-tower ticket (Bell OR Drum) is about ¥30; the combined ticket for both is about ¥50. Go up near dusk — the old city lights up around you.

西安钟楼登楼票约¥30（约4美元），而登比萨斜塔约22美元。钟楼建于1384年，1582年整体东移约1000米。你会为哪座塔的登楼票买单——比萨斜塔还是西安钟楼？
